Work through the five phases in order. When you scope the next piece of work, use the lessons recorded in Phase 5.

## The lifecycle

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-lifecycle.qmd >}}

## Go to a phase

```{=html}
<ul class="pb-phase-cards">
  <li>
    <a href="../../guidance/01-engagement-and-scoping/index.html">
      <img src="../../static/photos/phase-1-engagement-and-scoping.jpg" alt="">
      <div class="pb-phase-body">
        <span class="pb-phase-n">Phase 1</span>
        <span class="pb-phase-name">Engagement and scoping</span>
        <p>Agree the question with your commissioner, and score the impact.</p>
      </div>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a href="../../guidance/02-design/index.html">
      <img src="../../static/photos/phase-2-design.jpg" alt="">
      <div class="pb-phase-body">
        <span class="pb-phase-n">Phase 2</span>
        <span class="pb-phase-name">Design</span>
        <p>Choose the method, score the likelihood to get your level, and plan the assurance it requires.</p>
      </div>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a href="../../guidance/03-analysis/index.html">
      <img src="../../static/photos/phase-3-analysis.jpg" alt="">
      <div class="pb-phase-body">
        <span class="pb-phase-n">Phase 3</span>
        <span class="pb-phase-name">Analysis</span>
        <p>Collect the data, do the analysis, record your assumptions, and have your critical friend review it.</p>
      </div>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a href="../../guidance/04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.html">
      <img src="../../static/photos/phase-4-delivery-and-sign-off.jpg" alt="">
      <div class="pb-phase-body">
        <span class="pb-phase-n">Phase 4</span>
        <span class="pb-phase-name">Delivery, communication and sign-off</span>
        <p>Deliver it with its caveats and quality assurance statement, and get it signed off.</p>
      </div>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a href="../../guidance/05-review/index.html">
      <img src="../../static/photos/phase-5-review.jpg" alt="">
      <div class="pb-phase-body">
        <span class="pb-phase-n">Phase 5</span>
        <span class="pb-phase-name">Review</span>
        <p>Ask whether it informed the decision, and whether it is still right.</p>
      </div>
    </a>
  </li>
</ul>
```
